description: Explicit Artificial Analysis -> OpenRouter model identity mapping. Curated by humans: automatic matching must never silently extend this file. `status: confirmed` = identity verified against both catalogs; `provisional` = plausible but unverified, the collector surfaces these in every run report. `aaModelId` holds the Artificial Analysis model UUID when known; until curated it repeats the AA slug as a placeholder. `openrouterId` is the stable OpenRouter model id (no date suffix, no :variant, no ~ alias); the collector resolves the canonical date-suffixed slug at runtime via /api/v1/models.
